onboard.heading: Connect your Claude account
onboard.intro:
This app reads your quota from the account you are logged into in Claude Code.
(Read-only — your token is never stored or sent anywhere.)
onboard.steps:
Steps:
1) Install Claude Code  (npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code)
2) Open a terminal, type  claude  and run  /login
3) Sign in with your Claude account (Pro/Max/Team) in the browser
4) Come back and click "Check again" below
onboard.connected: ✅ Connected! You can close this window
onboard.not_found: ❌ No login found yet — follow the steps and try again
onboard.opening: Opening a terminal for login… When done, click "Check again"
onboard.no_cli: ⚠ claude command not found — install Claude Code first
about.description:
A small Windows tray app that tracks your Claude Code token quota in real time. The icon changes colour as your quota runs down (green > orange > red), and a click opens a dashboard with the details.

It reads the local credentials read-only to show your own usage — your token is never stored or sent anywhere.
